title: StrataCouncil
description: The council elected by the owners to exercise the powers and perform the duties of the strata corporation for a term.
x-validationRules: termEndDate must be on or after termStartDate.
Terms of councils for one strata corporation should not overlap.

id.description: Stable identifier of this StrataCouncil record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

termEndDate.description: Date the council's term ended, if it has.

electedAtMeetingId.description: General meeting at which the council was elected.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
